name: number
summary: Displays app-formatted number text with an optional decorative digit roll.

agent.useWhen: A text value should optionally roll changed digits after an app-owned update.
agent.avoidWhen: The value needs parsing, localization, financial calculation, inferred trend, or numeric interpolation.

native.scope: The locked declaration and browser installer require a real Native host build and browser lifecycle qualification.

invariants: Value is app-formatted, nonblank escaped text with no control characters; unknown properties are rejected.
Optional stable id uses a typed safe token (ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, underscore, colon; at most 128 bytes; no leading underscore); unknown properties are rejected.
Motion defaults to none; direction defaults to up; durationMs defaults to 320 and is bounded from 0 through 1000, with zero snapping immediately.

The first paint is canonical static text and never animates on mount. Explicit roll motion animates clipped old/new pairs only for changed ASCII digits of matching textual shape. Recognized digit-count/grouping shape changes and ASCII suffix changes use a bounded whole-label transition; sign changes, other separator edits, RTL values, and unsupported/long text settle without animation.

The app updates only data-cui-number-value with its already-formatted label. A stable id permits the trusted host patch bridge to retain the owned DOM node; the installer admits only the Number value, motion, duration, direction, and presentation class from a matching incoming Number root. The canonical label updates after the synchronous patch; decorative motion is aria-hidden, never a live region, and respects reduced motion.

Matching-shape ASCII digit edits roll in the configured direction; bounded printable shape/suffix changes use a whole-label transition. Incompatible, overlong, RTL, or unsupported labels settle to canonical text.
The component owns no domain state, parsing, localization, transport, financial operation, or command callback.
